sanitizedEvidence.summary: The validation build bound the exact RZ09-0581 BIOS 4.00 installation, Balanced and Automatic baseline, admitted full-power adapter, confirmed physical pad absence, one exact Service, one exact Session Agent, and a one-time lifecycle-validation manifest.
The installed Service applied HyperBoost once, confirmed mode 7, finalized durable ownership, and created the private marker without cleanup or manual recovery.
Windows Kernel-Power recorded ordered Modern Standby entry for a screen-off request and exit for keyboard input during the armed validation window.

Read-only FirmwareSmoke verification confirmed stable Balanced and Automatic state, a retired journal, the expected same-Service boundary, and exactly one matching Service recovery attempt and completion.

The private arm, marker, diagnostics, Windows event records, and verification result remain uncommitted; this annotation retains only bounded hashes, lengths, semantic outcomes, and exact executable provenance.

limitations: This run validates one installed-Service low-power restoration on the exact RZ09-0581 BIOS 4.00 generation, Balanced and Automatic, admitted full-power adapter, and confirmed physical pad absence.

The verifier accepts either the registered suspend callback or the narrow Modern Standby display-off fallback and proves exactly one restoration; it does not claim which notification path won the serialized race.
The earlier failed low-power run remains preserved as negative evidence for the pre-fix implementation.

productionAdmission.reason: The exact installed Service completed one owned padless HyperBoost restoration across an observed Modern Standby entry and exit, and all independent padless admission gates now have reviewed positive evidence.

notes: FirmwareSmoke verification was read-only and issued no recovery write.
